producer_report.summary: Hestia's own requests are now capped at high: root-cause, backfill (BACKFILL_URGENT removed), spec and throughput (high from 5+ minutes). The error review and backfill no longer re-queue a cause whose request a person closed with `athena close`, unless a newer introspection of that cause was recorded after the close. Requests closed by Hestia's own requeue, or rejected or failed, are still queued. Doc comments, docs/design/hestia.md, three docs/spec.toml lines and the CHANGELOG are updated. In this send-back pass I only fixed the remaining docs/spec.toml mentions of urgent. The fmt, clippy and full-suite checks were not run by me.

criteria_check.criterion: A test in crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs shows that plan_backfill over records with more than five repeated causes queues every request at Priority::High or lower (none urgent), and that root_cause_request produces a `Priority: high` request, not urgent. Run `cargo test -p athena-core hestia`.
criteria_check.evidence: Tests plan_backfill_over_more_than_five_causes_queues_every_request_at_high_or_lower and the_root_cause_request_is_high_and_refuses_a_cause_that_reads_as_acceptance pass in `cargo test -p athena-core hestia`.

criteria_check.criterion: A test shows a cause whose earlier request was closed with `athena close` (the manage.rs close path) gets no new request or requeue from the backfill or the per-job error review. A second case shows it is queued again, at high, once a new introspection of that cause is recorded after the close. Run `cargo test -p athena-core hestia`.

The backfill and the error review still queue a cause whose request was closed by Hestia itself (requeue Dropped) or was rejected or failed. A test covers at least one of these. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.
criteria_check.evidence: Test a_cause_whose_request_hestia_closed_to_queue_it_again_is_still_queued passes in the hestia run.

criteria_check.criterion: BACKFILL_URGENT and the Priority::Urgent uses in Hestia's request builders (root-cause, spec_request, throughput priority_for_minutes) are removed or capped at High. Grep shows no Priority::Urgent in non-test code of hestia.rs. `athena priority` and a person-written `Priority: urgent` line are unchanged: the plan.rs/store.rs parsing of urgent is untouched.
criteria_check.evidence: Tests a_speed_requirement_is_high_never_urgent..., request_priority_rises_with_the_expected_minutes_saved and the_backfill_does_not_lower_a_request_a_person_made_urgent pass. git status shows plan.rs and store.rs untouched.

criteria_check.criterion: Doc comments in hestia.rs (module docs, plan_backfill, root_cause_request) and any docs mention of urgent for Hestia are updated to say high at most.
criteria_check.evidence: hestia.rs comments, docs/design/hestia.md and docs/spec.toml (3 lines) now say high, never urgent. A grep of docs for urgent shows only the person-facing priority docs remain.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` all pass.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry that names the cap at high and the no-requeue after a person's close.
criteria_check.evidence: CHANGELOG.md has 15 added lines in git diff --stat.

mistakes: The first pass missed the urgent mentions in docs/spec.toml.
learnings: docs/spec.toml mechanism strings also describe Hestia priorities, so check it when changing priorities.
